description: The beginning of the Great Journey (Mahaprasthanika). The five Pandavas and Draupadi walk the Himalayan path toward heaven. A narrow ascending trail. This is the start — no combat, only the journey.

PANDAVA.note: All five Pandavas + Draupadi spawn together as a group. No enemies.

directive_notes.note: This is a walking simulator with narrative triggers, not combat. The journey itself is the test.

special_mechanics.no_combat: This map has no enemies. It's purely a movement/narrative map. Reaching the exit tile triggers transition to the next map.
